justification: OC-21 (approved rewording): no rule sits where the page query can never return it, except area rules with no map yet, which are withheld, listed, and announced on the address page. 2026-10-17: Ku-ring-gai 14G Pymble Business Park outline fitted from the plan's vector lot lines (IoU 0.944 vs Figure 14G.1-1, picture looked at) and loaded, 97 rows keyed; ten other C-B/KRG areas refused by the fit (IoU < 0.85) and listed with Parramatta Part 8 intros and one Ashfield contents row.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any served rule sits on the precinct layer with no key and is not in the not-covered list, or sits in a layer/condition the page never sends
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-17: 1,156 before; 1,076 after keying 14G (live: 21 Ryde Rd Pymble gets 81 14G rules, 2 Mona Vale Rd gets 0); 0 after listing the refused areas.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: each listed chapter's own figure (shape IoU recorded in data/area_map_checks/candidates_report.json) and the production address answer for in/out addresses

real_layer_exempt.scripts/fit_area_maps.py: read-only fitting tool; its real-layer checks are the address-register in/out test against production and the shape score against the PDF figure, both recorded per target

pre_impl.existing_data: KRG outlines 14A/14D/14E use lga and former_council 'Ku-ring-gai'
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: the zone route for 14C/14F failed IoU (0.51-0.70), so those stay listed
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: one fitting script, one keying rule, list entries

functions.name: main
functions.input: the target chapters' figures and the cadastre and road layers
functions.output: candidate outlines with shape score, address proof and a check picture, or a refusal
functions.if_none: a target with no passing fit is refused and written nowhere

break_it.scenario: 14G keyed to the whole business park serves street-group controls to every park lot
break_it.what_happens: a control for the Ryde Road group shows on a West Street lot
break_it.how: all lots are one zone (E3) inside one precinct; sub-groups recorded as residual

break_it.scenario: listing hides rules that could be mapped
break_it.what_happens: OC-21 passes while rules stay hidden
break_it.how: each entry names why (IoU below 0.85 or unreadable figure) and the page tells the user; the list is the work list for maps

break_it.scenario: a future publish re-keys or un-keys rows
break_it.what_happens: DQ-146 rises and OC-21 goes red
break_it.how: DQ-146 runs in CI; listed ids are exact

mutation_analysis: Removing the new list entries restores DQ-146 1,076; dropping the 14G rule leaves its 97 rows unkeyed.
residual_risk: Ten area chapters (C-B 7.3, 11.14, 8.2, 11.6, 11.5, 8.3 parts, 6.3, 11.2; KRG 14C, 14F) are not served to their own land until a fit passes. 14G street-group sub-areas are not separated. Address proof for 14G: 6/7 inside, 11/14 outside correct (edge points).
